n: Playful NLP activities for middle school (embeddings card game)
t: Three playful activities on word embeddings, language models, and chatbots for ages 11 to 14.
steps: Find the AAAI 2026 paper on playful NLP activities for middle school.
Look for the materials link. None was found during research, and the paper is under embargo until March 2027.
Print the card game materials once they are found.
Try the chatbot game yourself first.
Ask IT to review the chatbot game site.
Plan which of the three activities fits your class time.
